document:
Exercise: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- hinge
- pull

Primary Muscles:

- forearms

Secondary Muscles:

- biceps
- shoulders

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC and glycolytic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- enhance_shoulder_stability_and_mobility
- build_explosive_power
- develop_grip_strength

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position (Single Arm), instructions: ['Perform the exercise with one arm at a time.']
- name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position (With Pause), instructions: ['Pause briefly at the bottom position before initiating the upward movement.']

Substitution Options:

- name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position (Dumbbells), equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Initiate the exercise by standing upright with a kettlebell in one hand.
- Swing the kettlebell back forcefully and then reverse the motion forcefully. Crush the kettlebell handle as hard as possible and raise the kettlebell to your shoulder.
